people.name: Nabal
people.line: Wealthy Carmelite; husband of Abigail. He was known for foolishness.

translations.web: About ten days later, Yahweh struck Nabal, so that he died.
translations.bsb: About ten days later, the LORD struck Nabal dead.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass about ten days after, that the LORD smote Nabal, that he died.
translations.asv: And it came to pass about ten days after, that Jehovah smote Nabal, so that he died.
